description: Request body of the self-service email confirm / change challenge (POST /{tenant-id}/v1/me/email/confirm).

new_email.description: The address the verification code is sent to. Equal to the current address means re-verification; a different address means a change. Persisted as the user's email (and, under an EMAIL identity policy, as preferred_username), so its shape is bounded here before any mail is sent. The pattern is the pragmatic local@domain.tld check, not full RFC 5322 - deliverability is proven by the code round-trip. 'format': 'email' is not used because JsonPropertyFormat has no EMAIL entry, so it would silently pass everything.
